source.text: 湯谷上有扶木。一日方至，一日方出，皆載于烏。
東南海之外，甘水之間，有羲和之國。有女子名曰羲和，方浴日於甘淵。羲和者，帝俊之妻，生十日。

inferred.basis: 目录沿用传统通称金乌；所引大荒东经此段只写乌，没有金乌专名、金色或三足。名称不能反推本段明记三足金色。

inferred.item: 双足乌形与具体鸟体比例
inferred.basis: 据正文乌作乌鸟形；本段未记足数、趾数、喙形、胸颈和羽翼比例。双足、稍厚的短直喙、较低腿位、前倾胸颈和略宽的楔形尾羽均为设计选择，不把三足写入 source。

inferred.item: 墨黑青灰羽色、深灰喙足与黑褐眼
inferred.basis: 本段没有细部配色或金色记录；墨黑羽面、青灰层次、喙足和眼色全部为艺术设色，未加日冕或火羽。

inferred.item: 地面缓步与双足支撑舒翼
inferred.basis: 载日是正文描述，具体步态、呼吸、低头、尾羽摆动及双足着地的舒翼展示为交互演绎；不将这些动作或起落方式冒作原文。
所引两段均未记乌的鸣声；短鸣的声色、频率、节奏和空间位置为艺术补足。

sourceVerification.eastContextBefore: 大荒之中，有山名曰孽搖頵羝，上有扶木，柱三百里，其葉如芥。有谷曰溫源谷。
sourceVerification.note: 逐字核对 action=raw 底本文字，去除注释。载日乌据大荒东经；羲和生十日另据大荒南经独立列引，不拼成连续段落，也不沿用旧目录误标的海外东经。站点大荒东经开头另置带袁珂移文校注的羲和段，本项不以该移文拼接载日段。三足及金色不见于所引正文。

parentAudit.source: 父独立复核大荒东经载乌与大荒南经羲和段，分条引用；三足与金色不移入正文。

master.audit: Reuse of the already audited master: credits.log Extreme-High UUID, raw SHA256 and actual 50,000 raw triangles; cleaned normalized master rechecked byte hash and 49,902 triangles. Read-only source. No new generation, Medium, remeshing or simplification.

production.adaptation: Original dense bird surfaces and feather UV detail retained. Thicker shortened corvid bill, fuller forward breast, shorter lower legs/neck, slightly narrower wing span and broader raised wedge tail distinguish the shape. Charcoal repaint removes inherited white bill/red feet/brow contrast. Positive transformations only; guarded numerical-Jacobian inverse-transpose corrects original corner normals, never computeVertexNormals. Native two legs/toes retained and individually leveled before binding. No new geometric parts are claimed HIGH.
production.rig: Own 19-bone two-foot bird rig with independent sagittal foot-contact IK and counter-rotated rigid soles. Original idle 4s, walk 1.6s at 0.12 units/s / 0.70 stance duty, grounded alert 4.6s. Runtime travel is straight with no continuous support yaw; special maps to alert and returns idle. 120 Hz LINEAR samples are preserved with --resample false.
production.compression: gltf-transform optimize --simplify false --flatten false --join false --instance false --palette false --resample false --texture-compress webp --texture-size 2048 --compress meshopt
